name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
desc: Dominates reasoning and multimodal tasks. Scored 77% on ARC-AGI-2 — double its predecessor — and leads on graduate-level science benchmarks.

desc: xAI's current flagship for chat and code at $2/$6 with 500K context. Arena grok-4.6-high ~1461 Elo overall; Code Arena WebDev 1629 now sits well behind Claude Fable 5.1.
